ns2:course.label: Arch Design & Exploration
ns2:course.description: (ARCH 372) Schematic design, design development, and construction documents of a small scale (10,000 square feet) public building emphasizing the integration of the basic elements of building, structural, and environmental technologies. 6 undergraduate hours. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ARCH 475; credit or concurrent registration in ARCH 341and ARCH 342.
